units.source_text: 贺茂祭之日，源氏不胜寂寞，说道：“今日观赏祭典，想必人人都很欢欣。”

en.t: On the day of the Kamo Festival, Genji felt unbearably lonely and said, "Everyone must be very happy watching the festival today."

units.source_text: 独自想象各寺院繁华热闹之状。

en.t: Alone, he imagined how splendidly lively all the temples must be.

units.source_text: 后来又说：“众侍女何等寂寞！

en.t: Later he said again, "How lonely all the ladies-in-waiting must be!

units.source_text: 大家悄悄地回家去观赏祭典吧。”

en.t: You should all quietly go home and watch the festival."

units.source_text: 中将君正在东面一室中打瞌睡。

en.t: Chujo no Kimi was dozing in a room on the east side.

units.source_text: 源氏走进去看她，但见此人身材小巧玲珑，非常可爱。

en.t: Genji went in to look at her and saw that she was petite and delicate, very lovely.

units.source_text: 她起身相迎，双颊微红，娇艳动人，立刻举袖掩面。

en.t: She rose to greet him, her cheeks faintly flushed and her beauty captivating, and at once raised her sleeve to hide her face.

units.source_text: 鬓发稍稍蓬松，而青丝长垂，异常优美。

en.t: Her hair at the temples was slightly tousled, while her black hair hung long, extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 身穿略带黄色的红裙和萱草色单衫，上罩深黑色丧服，穿得随意不拘。

en.t: She wore a slightly yellowish red skirt and a daylily-colored unlined robe, with a deep black mourning robe over them, dressed in an informal, unrestrained way.

units.source_text: 外面的围裙和唐装都脱在一旁，看见源氏主君进来，意欲取来穿上。

en.t: Her outer skirt and Chinese-style jacket had both been taken off and set aside; seeing Lord Genji enter, she meant to fetch them and put them on.

units.source_text: 源氏看见她身旁放着一枝葵花，便取在手中，问道：“这是什么花？

en.t: Genji noticed a spray of mallow blossoms beside her, took it in his hand, and asked, "What flower is this?

units.source_text: 我连它的名字都忘记了。”

en.t: I have even forgotten its name."
Chujo no Kimi answered with a poem:
